quote: Intestinal morphology of Chinese perch fed diets containing different levels of arginine for 56 days: (A) 2.61%; (B) 2.99%; (C) 3.37%; (D) 3.82%.
statement: 展示了喂食不同水平精氨酸饲料56天的鳜鱼肠道形态。
text_zh: 展示了喂食不同水平精氨酸饲料56天的鳜鱼肠道形态。
text_en: Shows the intestinal morphology of mandarin fish fed diets with different levels of arginine for 56 days.

quote: Arginine has been shown to increase antioxidant capacity by stimulating GSH synthesis and modulating the Nrf2-Keap1 pathway (Liang et al., 2018b).
statement: 已有研究证明精氨酸通过刺激谷胱甘肽（GSH）合成和调节Nrf2-Keap1通路来增强抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 已有研究证明精氨酸通过刺激谷胱甘肽（GSH）合成和调节Nrf2-Keap1通路来增强抗氧化能力。
text_en: Existing studies have demonstrated that arginine enhances antioxidant capacity by stimulating glutathione (GSH) synthesis and regulating the Nrf2-Keap1 pathway.

quote:
Feeding ﬁsh with 3.82% arginine
signiﬁcantly (P < 0.05) affected genes involved in the PI3K-Akt
signaling pathway, the MAPK signaling pathway, tight junctions,
the Rap1 signaling pathway, focal adhesion, the Ras signaling
pathway, regulation of the actin cytoskeleton, cell adhesion
molecules, leukocyte transendothelial migration, etc.
statement: 喂食含3.82%精氨酸的饲料显著影响了涉及PI3K-Akt信号通路、MAPK信号通路、紧密连接、Rap1信号通路、粘着斑、Ras信号通路、肌动蛋白细胞骨架调节、细胞粘附分子和白细胞跨内皮迁移等的基因。
text_zh: 喂食含3.82%精氨酸的饲料显著影响了涉及PI3K-Akt信号通路、MAPK信号通路、紧密连接、Rap1信号通路、粘着斑、Ras信号通路、肌动蛋白细胞骨架调节、细胞粘附分子和白细胞跨内皮迁移等的基因。
text_en: Feeding fish with 3.82% arginine significantly affected genes involved in the PI3K-Akt signaling pathway, MAPK signaling pathway, tight junctions, Rap1 signaling pathway, focal adhesion, Ras signaling pathway, regulation of actin cytoskeleton, cell adhesion molecules, and leukocyte transendothelial migration.
outcome: 细胞连接及免疫迁移相关基因表达

quote: Dietary arginine levels did signiﬁcantly inﬂuence TSOD activity in the serum, liver, and intestines of S. chuatsi (P < 0.05); ﬁsh fed a 3.37% arginine diet had the highest TSOD activity in the serum and liver, which was signiﬁcantly higher than those of the control group and 3.82% arginine group (P < 0.05).
statement: 饲料精氨酸水平显著影响血清、肝脏和肠道的总超氧化物歧化酶（TSOD）活性，3.37%精氨酸组的血清和肝脏TSOD活性最高且显著高于对照组和3.82%组。
text_zh: 饲料精氨酸水平显著影响血清、肝脏和肠道的总超氧化物歧化酶（TSOD）活性，3.37%精氨酸组的血清和肝脏TSOD活性最高且显著高于对照组和3.82%组。
text_en: Dietary arginine levels significantly affected total superoxide dismutase (TSOD) activity in serum, liver, and intestine; the 3.37% arginine group had the highest serum and liver TSOD activities, which were significantly higher than those of the control group and the 3.82% group.

quote: The MDA content was also signiﬁcantly affected by the dietary arginine levels; ﬁsh fed a 3.37% arginine diet had the lowest liver MDA content (P < 0.05).
statement: 饲料精氨酸水平显著影响丙二醛（MDA）含量，3.37%精氨酸组的肝脏MDA含量最低。
text_zh: 饲料精氨酸水平显著影响丙二醛（MDA）含量，3.37%精氨酸组的肝脏MDA含量最低。
text_en: Dietary arginine levels significantly affected malondialdehyde (MDA) content; the liver MDA content was lowest in the 3.37% arginine group.

quote: Studies have reported that a 2.31% dietary arginine level resulted in the upregulation of the relative gene expression of IRS-1, PI3K, and Akt in the insulin signaling pathway (improving glycolysis), while a 2.70% dietary arginine level led to inhibition of these genes (high plasma glucose) in juvenile blunt snout bream Megalobrama amblycephala (Liang et al., 2017).
statement: 据报道，在团头鲂幼鱼中，2.31%的日粮精氨酸水平上调了胰岛素信号通路中IRS-1、PI3K和Akt的相对基因表达（改善糖酵解），而2.70%的日粮精氨酸水平抑制了这些基因（高血浆葡萄糖）。
text_zh: 据报道，在团头鲂幼鱼中，2.31%的日粮精氨酸水平上调了胰岛素信号通路中IRS-1、PI3K和Akt的相对基因表达（改善糖酵解），而2.70%的日粮精氨酸水平抑制了这些基因（高血浆葡萄糖）。
text_en: It is reported that in juvenile blunt snout bream, a dietary arginine level of 2.31% upregulated the relative gene expression of IRS-1, PI3K and Akt in the insulin signaling pathway (improving glycolysis), while a dietary arginine level of 2.70% inhibited these genes (high plasma glucose).

quote: However, the mandarin fish industry has been threatened by viral diseases, including infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus (ISKNV).
statement: 鳜鱼养殖业受到包括传染性脾肾坏死病毒（ISKNV）在内的病毒性疾病的威胁。
text_zh: 鳜鱼养殖业受到包括传染性脾肾坏死病毒（ISKNV）在内的病毒性疾病的威胁。
text_en: The mandarin fish aquaculture industry is threatened by viral diseases, including infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus (ISKNV).

quote: In recent years, frequently ISKNV disease outbreak has resulted in substantial economic losses to the mandarin fish industry due to high post-infection (pi) mortality rates [ 8 ].
statement: 近年来，ISKNV疾病频繁爆发导致鳜鱼产业遭受重大经济损失，原因是感染后死亡率很高。
text_zh: 近年来，ISKNV疾病频繁爆发导致鳜鱼产业遭受重大经济损失，原因是感染后死亡率很高。
text_en: In recent years, frequent outbreaks of ISKNV disease have caused major economic losses to the mandarin fish industry because of the high mortality rate after infection.

quote: The fish were anaesthetized with MS-222 (40 mg/L, Sigma–Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA) prior to tissue sampling.
statement: 在组织取样前，鱼类使用MS-222（40 mg/L）进行麻醉。
text_zh: 在组织取样前，鱼类使用MS-222（40 mg/L）进行麻醉。
text_en: Fish were anesthetized with MS-222 (40 mg/L) before tissue sampling.

quote: The enrichment of Cetobacterium could also be observed with additional probiotic treatment (Wang et al., 2020).
statement: 额外的益生菌处理也可以观察到Cetobacterium的富集。
text_zh: 额外的益生菌处理也可以观察到Cetobacterium的富集。
text_en: Enrichment of Cetobacterium can also be observed with additional probiotic treatment.

quote: Meanwhile, Ofek et al. (2022) also conﬁrmed that the abundance of Cetobacterium was lower in infected tilapia than in healthy tilapia.
statement: Ofek等人（2022）也证实，受感染的罗非鱼中Cetobacterium的丰度低于健康罗非鱼。
text_zh: Ofek等人（2022）也证实，受感染的罗非鱼中Cetobacterium的丰度低于健康罗非鱼。
text_en: Ofek et al. (2022) also confirmed that the abundance of Cetobacterium in infected tilapia was lower than in healthy tilapia.

quote: The enhancement of Cetobacterium by arginine can be explored to ameliorate the deleterious effects of high carbohydrate in diets.
statement: 精氨酸对Cetobacterium的增强作用可用于探索以改善高碳水化合物日粮的有害影响。
text_zh: 精氨酸对Cetobacterium的增强作用可用于探索以改善高碳水化合物日粮的有害影响。
text_en: The enhancing effect of arginine on Cetobacterium can be used to explore improving the harmful effects of high-carbohydrate diets.
outcome: 缓解高碳水日粮负面影响

quote: Cetobacterium might act as the key species in maintaining ﬁsh health and providing protection against some pathogenic bacteria.
statement: Cetobacterium可能作为维持鱼类健康和抵御某些致病菌的关键物种。
text_zh: Cetobacterium可能作为维持鱼类健康和抵御某些致病菌的关键物种。
text_en: Cetobacterium may serve as a key species for maintaining fish health and resisting certain pathogenic bacteria.

quote: Overall, the increase of Cetobacterium might strengthen interactions among gut microbes and improve host resistance to pathogen infections.
statement: 总体而言，Cetobacterium的增加可能会增强肠道微生物间的相互作用并提高宿主对病原体感染的抵抗力。
text_zh: 总体而言，Cetobacterium的增加可能会增强肠道微生物间的相互作用并提高宿主对病原体感染的抵抗力。
text_en: Overall, the increase in Cetobacterium may enhance interactions among gut microbiota and improve host resistance to pathogen infection.

quote: Our results revealed that although growth performance was not signiﬁcantly inﬂuenced by dietary arginine supplementation, antioxidant capacity, intestinal digestion, and nutritional metabolism were signiﬁcantly impacted in Chinese perch.
statement: 我们的结果显示，虽然日粮精氨酸补充没有显著影响生长性能，但显著影响了鳜的抗氧化能力、肠道消化和营养代谢。
text_zh: 我们的结果显示，虽然日粮精氨酸补充没有显著影响生长性能，但显著影响了鳜的抗氧化能力、肠道消化和营养代谢。
text_en: Our results showed that although dietary arginine supplementation did not significantly affect growth performance, it significantly affected the antioxidant capacity, intestinal digestion and nutrient metabolism of mandarin fish.
outcome: 生长性能、抗氧化能力、肠道消化、营养代谢
counterevidence: growth performance was not signiﬁcantly inﬂuenced

quote: According to the results from this study, arginine supplementation modulated the bacterial community of Chinese perch.
statement: 根据本研究结果，精氨酸补充调节了鳜鱼的细菌群落。
text_zh: 根据本研究结果，精氨酸补充调节了鳜鱼的细菌群落。
text_en: According to the results of this study, arginine supplementation regulated the bacterial community of mandarin fish.

quote: the ISKNV viral loads were significantly reduced in sc TNKS1-like overexpression group compared to the empty vector group
statement: 与空载体组相比，sc TNKS1-like过表达组的ISKNV病毒载量显著降低。
text_zh: 与空载体组相比，sc TNKS1-like过表达组的ISKNV病毒载量显著降低。
text_en: Compared to the empty vector group, ISKNV viral load was significantly reduced in the sc TNKS1-like overexpression group.
counterevidence: 该结果与前文提到的病毒基因转录增加及作者结论（促进复制）存在矛盾。

quote: Vaccination is the most effective method for control of viral diseases.
statement: 疫苗接种是控制病毒性疾病最有效的方法。
text_zh: 疫苗接种是控制病毒性疾病最有效的方法。
text_en: Vaccination is the most effective method for controlling viral diseases.

quote: In recent years epidemic diseases, mainly caused by infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus (ISKNV) and Siniperca chuatsi rhabdovirus (SCRV), have seriously hindered the development of the mandarin fish farming industry
statement: 近年来，主要由传染性脾肾坏死病毒（ISKNV）和鳜鱼弹状病毒（SCRV）引起的流行病严重阻碍了鳜鱼养殖业的发展。
text_zh: 近年来，主要由传染性脾肾坏死病毒（ISKNV）和鳜鱼弹状病毒（SCRV）引起的流行病严重阻碍了鳜鱼养殖业的发展。
text_en: In recent years, epidemics caused mainly by Infectious Spleen and Kidney Necrosis Virus (ISKNV) and Siniperca Chuatsi Rhabdovirus (SCRV) have severely hindered the development of mandarin fish aquaculture.

quote: A research group from Sun Yat-sen University developed an inactivated ISKNV vaccine and have obtained the corresponding veterinary drug certificate (No. 75) in 2020.
statement: 中山大学的一个研究小组开发了一种灭活ISKNV疫苗，并于2020年获得了相应的兽药证书（第75号）。
text_zh: 中山大学的一个研究小组开发了一种灭活ISKNV疫苗，并于2020年获得了相应的兽药证书（第75号）。
text_en: A research group at Sun Yat-sen University developed an inactivated ISKNV vaccine and obtained the corresponding veterinary drug certificate (No. 75) in 2020.

quote: Zhang et al. [ 6 ] developed an inactivated ISKNV vaccine with chitosan as the adjuvant, which can play a significantly protective role against ISKNV infections.
statement: Zhang等人[6]开发了一种以壳聚糖为佐剂的灭活ISKNV疫苗，该疫苗对ISKNV感染具有显著的保护作用。
text_zh: Zhang等人[6]开发了一种以壳聚糖为佐剂的灭活ISKNV疫苗，该疫苗对ISKNV感染具有显著的保护作用。
text_en: Zhang et al. [6] developed an inactivated ISKNV vaccine adjuvanted with chitosan, which showed significant protective effects against ISKNV infection.
intervention: Inactivated ISKNV vaccine with chitosan adjuvant

quote: Zhang et al. [ 7 ] reported a clonal Micropterus salmoides rhabdovirus Sanshui-7 (MSRV-SS-7) strain as a potential live vaccine candidate for Chinese perch against SCRV disease.
statement: Zhang等人[7]报道了一种克隆鲈鱼弹状病毒三水-7（MSRV-SS-7）株，作为对抗SCRV疾病的潜在活疫苗候选物。
text_zh: Zhang等人[7]报道了一种克隆鲈鱼弹状病毒三水-7（MSRV-SS-7）株，作为对抗SCRV疾病的潜在活疫苗候选物。
text_en: Zhang et al. [7] reported a cloned sea bass rhabdovirus Sanxi-7 (MSRV-SS-7) strain as a potential live vaccine candidate against SCRV disease.

quote: Recently, our laboratory developed an ISKNV SCRV bivalent inactivated vaccine which can provide simultaneous protection against ISKNV and SCRV infections with a protection rate of more than 90% and 80%, respectively [ 8 ].
statement: 最近，我们的实验室开发了一种ISKNV-SCRV二价灭活疫苗，可同时对ISKNV和SCRV感染提供保护，保护率分别超过90%和80%。
text_zh: 最近，我们的实验室开发了一种ISKNV-SCRV二价灭活疫苗，可同时对ISKNV和SCRV感染提供保护，保护率分别超过90%和80%。
text_en: Recently, our laboratory developed an ISKNV-SCRV bivalent inactivated vaccine that provides protection against both ISKNV and SCRV infections, with protection rates exceeding 90% and 80%, respectively.

quote: We showed that expression of genes in several pathways, including retinal photosensitivity, circadian rhythm, appetite control, learning and memory, were significantly different in feeders and nonfeeders.
statement: 结果显示，在视网膜光敏感性、昼夜节律、食欲控制以及学习和记忆等通路中的基因表达在摄食者和非摄食者之间存在显著差异。
text_zh: 结果显示，在视网膜光敏感性、昼夜节律、食欲控制以及学习和记忆等通路中的基因表达在摄食者和非摄食者之间存在显著差异。
text_en: The results showed that gene expression in pathways related to retinal light sensitivity, circadian rhythm, appetite control, and learning and memory differed significantly between feeders and non-feeders.

quote: Down-regulation of orexigenic and up-regulation of anorexigenic genes in feeders were associated with lower appetite.
statement: 摄食者中促食欲基因的下调和抑食欲基因的上调与较低的食欲相关。
text_zh: 摄食者中促食欲基因的下调和抑食欲基因的上调与较低的食欲相关。
text_en: Downregulation of orexigenic genes and upregulation of anorexigenic genes in feeders are associated with lower appetite.

quote: The mRNA levels of Creb, c-fos, C/EBP, zif268, Bdnf and Syt were dramatically decreased in feeders, which might result in significant deficiency in memory retention of its natural food preference (live prey fish).
statement: 摄食者中Creb、c-fos、C/EBP、zif268、Bdnf和Syt的mRNA水平显著降低，这可能导致其对天然食物偏好（活饵）的记忆保持出现显著缺陷。
text_zh: 摄食者中Creb、c-fos、C/EBP、zif268、Bdnf和Syt的mRNA水平显著降低，这可能导致其对天然食物偏好（活饵）的记忆保持出现显著缺陷。
text_en: The mRNA levels of Creb, c-fos, C/EBP, zif268, Bdnf and Syt in feeders were significantly reduced, which may lead to a significant deficit in memory retention for natural food preference (live bait).

quote: Compared with nonfeeders, the mRNA levels of Pomc, Pyy and leptin were significantly increased, whereas Npy and ghrelin were decreased significantly and slightly, respectively.
statement: 与不摄食者相比，摄食者的Pomc、Pyy和瘦素的mRNA水平显著升高，而Npy和ghrelin分别显著和轻微降低。
text_zh: 与不摄食者相比，摄食者的Pomc、Pyy和瘦素的mRNA水平显著升高，而Npy和ghrelin分别显著和轻微降低。
text_en: Compared to non-feeders, the mRNA levels of Pomc, Pyy and leptin were significantly increased in feeders, while Npy and ghrelin were significantly and slightly decreased, respectively.
outcome: 食欲控制相关基因表达

quote: We observed lower expression of orexigenic genes (Npy, proenkephalin, Gh, uncoupling protein 2 (Ucp2), Creb, eukaryotic initiation factor (eIF) 4E binding protein (4Ebp1), tuberous sclerosis 1 (Tsc1), ghrelin and leptin receptor gene-related protein (Ob-rgrp)) and higher expression of anorexigenic genes (Pomc, Pyy, preprosomatostatin (Srif), insulin, leptin, cholecystokinin (Cck) and tachykinin 1) in feeders compared with nonfeeders
statement: 与不摄食者相比，摄食者的促食欲基因表达较低，而抑食欲基因表达较高。
text_zh: 与不摄食者相比，摄食者的促食欲基因表达较低，而抑食欲基因表达较高。
text_en: Compared to non-feeders, feeders had lower expression of orexigenic genes and higher expression of anorexigenic genes.

quote: The changes in gene expression suggested that feeders had decreased appetite.
statement: 基因表达的变化表明摄食者的食欲下降。
text_zh: 基因表达的变化表明摄食者的食欲下降。
text_en: Changes in gene expression indicate a decrease in appetite in feeders.

quote: Mandarin fish might not be able to accomplish its relatively long process of prey recognition before the offered food pellet has fallen down to the bottom of the tank and can no longer be perceived by its sensory organs.
statement: 鳜鱼可能无法在投喂的饲料颗粒沉入水底并超出其感官感知范围之前完成相对较长的猎物识别过程。
text_zh: 鳜鱼可能无法在投喂的饲料颗粒沉入水底并超出其感官感知范围之前完成相对较长的猎物识别过程。
text_en: Mandarin fish may be unable to complete the relatively long prey recognition process before the fed feed pellets sink to the bottom and exceed their sensory perception range.

quote: The more strict selection of prey motion and shape also makes it more difficult to feed mandarin fish with artificial diets and dead prey fish.
statement: 对猎物运动和形状的严格选择使得用人工饲料和死饵喂养鳜鱼更加困难。
text_zh: 对猎物运动和形状的严格选择使得用人工饲料和死饵喂养鳜鱼更加困难。
text_en: Strict selection of prey movement and shape makes it more difficult to feed mandarin fish with artificial feed and dead bait.
intervention: Feeding artificial feed or dead bait

quote: Hence much better developed visual ability could improve the mandarin fish to accept dead prey fish or artificial diets [ 11 ].
statement: 因此，更发达的视觉能力可能有助于提高鳜鱼接受死饵鱼或人工饲料的能力。
text_zh: 因此，更发达的视觉能力可能有助于提高鳜鱼接受死饵鱼或人工饲料的能力。
text_en: Therefore, more developed visual ability may help improve the acceptance of dead bait fish or artificial feed by mandarin fish.

quote: During the training period, the fish were visually sorted into feeders and nonfeeders on the basis of plumpness or emaciation, respectively.
statement: 在训练期间，根据鱼体的丰满或消瘦程度，通过视觉将鱼分为摄食者和非摄食者。
text_zh: 在训练期间，根据鱼体的丰满或消瘦程度，通过视觉将鱼分为摄食者和非摄食者。
text_en: During the training period, fish were visually classified into feeders and non-feeders based on their body condition (plumpness or thinness).
outcome: 个体健康状况/营养状态

quote: The training period did not cause the nonfeeders to starve to death because of the relatively short time and large size of the fish.
statement: 由于时间相对较短且鱼体较大，训练期并未导致非摄食者饿死。
text_zh: 由于时间相对较短且鱼体较大，训练期并未导致非摄食者饿死。
text_en: Due to the relatively short duration and the large body size of the fish, the training period did not cause non-feeders to starve.

quote: To eliminate the influence of hunger on the mRNA levels of mandarin fish, both groups were fed with live prey fish for two days after training.
statement: 为了消除饥饿对鳜鱼mRNA水平的影响，两组鱼在训练后均投喂活饵两天。
text_zh: 为了消除饥饿对鳜鱼mRNA水平的影响，两组鱼在训练后均投喂活饵两天。
text_en: To eliminate the effect of hunger on mRNA levels in mandarin fish, both groups of fish were fed live bait for two days after training.
outcome: 营养摄入/生理指标稳定性

quote: Effect of food pellet shape and texture on the feeding response of juvenile Atlantic salmon.
statement: Food pellet shape and texture affect the feeding response of juvenile Atlantic salmon.
text_en: Food pellet shape and texture affect the feeding response of juvenile Atlantic salmon.

quote: A behavioural method to test feeding responses of fish to pelleted diets.
statement: There is a behavioural method available to test feeding responses of fish to pelleted diets.
text_en: There is a behavioural method available to test feeding responses of fish to pelleted diets.

quote: In the current study, c-fos, Fra-2 and zif268 genes were expressed at significantly lower levels in feeders than in nonfeeders, suggesting disruption of LTP and memory formation in feeders [ 57 ].
statement: 本研究中，摄食者的c-fos、Fra-2和zif268基因表达水平显著低于不摄食者，表明摄食者的长时程增强（LTP）和记忆形成受到干扰。
text_zh: 本研究中，摄食者的c-fos、Fra-2和zif268基因表达水平显著低于不摄食者，表明摄食者的长时程增强（LTP）和记忆形成受到干扰。
text_en: In this study, the expression levels of c-fos, Fra-2 and zif268 genes in feeders were significantly lower than those in non-feeders, indicating that long-term potentiation (LTP) and memory formation in feeders were impaired.
outcome: 神经可塑性与记忆形成

quote: A major constraint in the culture of the mandarin fish ( Siniperca chuatsi ), an economically significant species in China, is its strong feeding preference for live prey and consequent poor acceptance of formulated diets
statement: 鳜鱼对活饵的强烈偏好导致其难以接受配合饲料，这是养殖的主要限制因素。

text_en: The strong preference of mandarin fish for live bait leads to difficulty in accepting formulated feed, which is a major limiting factor in aquaculture.
outcome: 摄食行为与饲料适应性

quote: This feeding habit necessitates the use of live bait, which increases production costs and elevates the risk of disease transmission, thereby limiting the sustainable development of mandarin fish farming.
statement: 使用活饵增加了生产成本并提高了疾病传播风险，从而限制了鳜鱼养殖的可持续发展。

text_en: Using live bait increased production costs and raised the risk of disease transmission, thereby limiting the sustainable development of mandarin fish farming.

quote: we employed transcriptome sequencing to perform an in-depth analysis of the intestinal tract of mandarin fish fed with TB-supplemented diets. Our objectives were to elucidate TB-mediated regulatory network of intestinal gene expression, delineate its modulatory effects on gut health and physiological function

text_en: This study used transcriptome sequencing to analyze the intestines of mandarin fish fed TB-supplemented feed, aiming to elucidate the TB-mediated intestinal gene expression regulatory network and its regulatory effects on intestinal health and physiological functions.

quote: All experimental procedures were approved by the Animal Experimentation Ethics Committee of Hebei Agricultural University... All procedures strictly adhered to the standards outlined in the Chinese Laboratory Animal Welfare Guidelines

text_en: All experimental procedures were approved by the Animal Experiment Ethics Committee of Hebei Agricultural University and strictly followed the standards of the Chinese Laboratory Animal Welfare Guidelines.

quote: TB supplementation improves productivity and health in farm animals by enhancing nutrient absorption and protein digestibility, achieved through its positive impacts on intestinal mucosal structure, barrier integrity, and key physiological processes such as antioxidant defense, inflammatory regulation, and mitochondrial efficiency.
statement: 丁酸梭菌（TB）补充剂通过改善肠道黏膜结构、屏障完整性以及抗氧化防御、炎症调节和线粒体效率等关键生理过程，从而提高农场动物的生产力和健康水平。
text_zh: 丁酸梭菌（TB）补充剂通过改善肠道黏膜结构、屏障完整性以及抗氧化防御、炎症调节和线粒体效率等关键生理过程，从而提高农场动物的生产力和健康水平。
text_en: Clostridium butyricum (TB) supplementation improves the productivity and health of farmed animals by enhancing key physiological processes such as intestinal mucosal structure, barrier integrity, antioxidant defense, inflammation regulation, and mitochondrial efficiency.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: Existing studies suggest that TB supplementation preserves intestinal health by improving villus integrity, increasing digestive enzyme activities, elevating antioxidant capacity, and suppressing inflammatory responses [ 18 ].
statement: 现有研究表明，TB补充剂通过改善绒毛完整性、增加消化酶活性、提高抗氧化能力和抑制炎症反应来保护水生生物的肠道健康。
text_zh: 现有研究表明，TB补充剂通过改善绒毛完整性、增加消化酶活性、提高抗氧化能力和抑制炎症反应来保护水生生物的肠道健康。
text_en: Existing studies show that TB supplementation protects the intestinal health of aquatic organisms by improving villus integrity, increasing digestive enzyme activity, enhancing antioxidant capacity, and inhibiting inflammatory responses.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: For example, in grass carp fed high-soybean meal diets, TB enhanced growth performance and attenuated pro-inflammatory responses by improving intestinal morphology, structural integrity, and microbial composition [ 19 ].
statement: 例如，在饲喂高豆粕日粮的草鱼中，TB通过改善肠道形态、结构完整性和微生物组成，增强了生长性能并减轻了促炎反应。
text_zh: 例如，在饲喂高豆粕日粮的草鱼中，TB通过改善肠道形态、结构完整性和微生物组成，增强了生长性能并减轻了促炎反应。
text_en: For example, in grass carp fed a high-soybean-meal diet, TB enhanced growth performance and alleviated pro-inflammatory responses by improving intestinal morphology, structural integrity, and microbial composition.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: We speculate that butyrate derived from TB may serve as a direct energy source for the intestinal epithelial cells, thereby promoting villus development, increasing the absorptive surface area, and ultimately improving intestinal health.
statement: 作者推测，源自TB的丁酸可能作为肠上皮细胞的直接能量来源，从而促进绒毛发育，增加吸收表面积，并最终改善肠道健康。
text_zh: 作者推测，源自TB的丁酸可能作为肠上皮细胞的直接能量来源，从而促进绒毛发育，增加吸收表面积，并最终改善肠道健康。
text_en: The authors speculate that butyrate derived from TB may serve as a direct energy source for intestinal epithelial cells, thereby promoting villus development, increasing the absorptive surface area, and ultimately improving gut health.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: The fish were randomly allocated to three experimental groups based on dietary TB supplementation levels: a control group (0 mg/kg TB), a low-dose TB group (500 mg/kg TB), and a high-dose TB group (1000 mg/kg TB)
statement: 实验将鳜鱼随机分为三组，分别饲喂含0、500和1000 mg/kg TB的饲料。
text_zh: 实验将鳜鱼随机分为三组，分别饲喂含0、500和1000 mg/kg TB的饲料。
text_en: The experiment randomly divided mandarin fish into three groups, fed diets containing 0, 500, and 1000 mg/kg TB, respectively.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: They were fed twice daily (08:00 and 16:00) until satiety was reached.
statement: 鱼类每天两次（08:00和16:00）喂食至饱食状态。
text_zh: 鱼类每天两次（08:00和16:00）喂食至饱食状态。
text_en: Fish were fed to satiation twice daily (08:00 and 16:00).

quote: In the hindgut, VH exhibited a dose-dependent increase, with the TB2 group showing the highest value, followed by TB1, and then the C group.
statement: 在后肠中，绒毛高度（VH）随TB剂量增加而呈剂量依赖性升高，TB2组最高，其次是TB1组，对照组最低。
text_zh: 在后肠中，绒毛高度（VH）随TB剂量增加而呈剂量依赖性升高，TB2组最高，其次是TB1组，对照组最低。
text_en: In the hindgut, villus height (VH) increased in a dose-dependent manner with increasing TB dosage; the TB2 group was the highest, followed by the TB1 group, and the control group was the lowest.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: Conversely, MT was significantly greater in both TB1 and TB2 groups compared to the C group, with no significant difference between the two treatment groups
statement: 相反，TB1和TB2组的黏膜厚度（MT）均显著高于对照组，且两个处理组之间无显著差异。
text_zh: 相反，TB1和TB2组的黏膜厚度（MT）均显著高于对照组，且两个处理组之间无显著差异。
text_en: In contrast, the mucosal thickness (MT) of both the TB1 and TB2 groups was significantly higher than that of the control group, with no significant difference between the two treatment groups.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: Tributyrin (TB), a stable derivative of butyric acid, has been widely used in animal feeds for its health-promoting effects.
statement: 三丁酸甘油酯作为丁酸的稳定衍生物，因其促进健康的效果而被广泛用于动物饲料中。

text_en: Tributyrin, as a stable derivative of butyric acid, is widely used in animal feed due to its health-promoting effects.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: This study evaluated the efficacy of dietary TB serving as a functional feed additive in enhancing intestinal health of mandarin fish ( Siniperca chuatsi ), with a focus on elucidating the associated molecular mechanisms.
statement: 本研究评估了日粮中添加三丁酸甘油酯作为功能性饲料添加剂在增强鳜鱼肠道健康方面的功效，并重点阐明相关的分子机制。
text_zh: 本研究评估了日粮中添加三丁酸甘油酯作为功能性饲料添加剂在增强鳜鱼肠道健康方面的功效，并重点阐明相关的分子机制。
text_en: This study evaluated the efficacy of adding tributyrin to the diet as a functional feed additive in enhancing gut health in mandarin fish, and focused on elucidating the related molecular mechanisms.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: A total of 300 juvenile mandarin fish (200.0 ± 5.2 g) were randomly assigned to one of three dietary groups: a control group (0 mg/kg TB), a low-dose TB group (TB1, 500 mg/kg), or a high-dose TB group (TB2, 1000 mg/kg).
statement: 将300尾幼鳜随机分为三个饮食组：对照组（0 mg/kg TB）、低剂量TB组（TB1，500 mg/kg）或高剂量TB组（TB2，1000 mg/kg）。
text_zh: 将300尾幼鳜随机分为三个饮食组：对照组（0 mg/kg TB）、低剂量TB组（TB1，500 mg/kg）或高剂量TB组（TB2，1000 mg/kg）。
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: The one-month feeding trial was conducted under strictly controlled conditions, with water quality maintained within optimal range.
statement: 为期一个月的饲养试验在严格控制的条件下进行，水质保持在最佳范围内。
text_zh: 为期一个月的饲养试验在严格控制的条件下进行，水质保持在最佳范围内。
text_en: A one-month feeding trial was conducted under strictly controlled conditions, with water quality maintained within the optimal range.

quote: Fish were fed their respective diets twice daily to apparent satiety.
statement: 每天两次给鱼投喂各自的日粮至表观饱食状态。
text_zh: 每天两次给鱼投喂各自的日粮至表观饱食状态。
text_en: Fish were fed their respective diets to apparent satiation twice daily.

quote: Results showed that TB supplementation significantly increased villus height in the mid- and hindgut, with the TB2 group showing the most pronounced improvement.
statement: 结果显示，补充三丁酸甘油酯显著增加了中肠和后肠的绒毛高度，其中TB2组的改善最为明显。
text_zh: 结果显示，补充三丁酸甘油酯显著增加了中肠和后肠的绒毛高度，其中TB2组的改善最为明显。
text_en: The results showed that supplementation with tributyrin significantly increased the villus height in the midgut and hindgut, with the TB2 group showing the most obvious improvement.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: supplementation of culture water with Bacillus cereus (10 8 PFU/mL) improved feed intake, growth, and survival under pellet feed conditions, likely mediated by stimulating innate immunity and remodeling the gut flora
statement: 在养殖水中补充蜡样芽孢杆菌（10^8 PFU/mL）改善了颗粒饲料条件下的摄食量、生长和存活率，这可能通过刺激先天免疫和重塑肠道菌群介导。
text_zh: 在养殖水中补充蜡样芽孢杆菌（10^8 PFU/mL）改善了颗粒饲料条件下的摄食量、生长和存活率，这可能通过刺激先天免疫和重塑肠道菌群介导。
text_en: Supplementing Bacillus cereus (10^8 PFU/mL) in the culture water improved feed intake, growth and survival under pelleted feed conditions, which may be mediated by stimulating innate immunity and reshaping gut microbiota.
intervention_record: 水体补充蜡样芽孢杆菌
outcome: 摄食量、生长、存活率、先天免疫、肠道菌群

quote: artificial compounded feeds often suffer from inherent deficiencies of poor palatability and low nutrient absorption
statement: 人工配合饲料通常存在适口性差和营养吸收低的固有缺陷。
text_zh: 人工配合饲料通常存在适口性差和营养吸收低的固有缺陷。
text_en: Artificial formulated feed usually has inherent defects of poor palatability and low nutrient absorption.

quote: Its widespread application in animal feeds stems from its efficacy in promoting health and enhancing growth metrics
statement: 三丁酸甘油酯在动物饲料中的广泛应用源于其在促进健康和提高生长指标方面的功效。
text_zh: 三丁酸甘油酯在动物饲料中的广泛应用源于其在促进健康和提高生长指标方面的功效。
text_en: The widespread use of tributyrin in animal feed stems from its efficacy in promoting health and improving growth indicators.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: This targeted release allows more butyrate molecules to exert their functions in the intestine, making TB an effective vehicle for butyrate delivery.
statement: 这种靶向释放使更多的丁酸盐分子在肠道中发挥作用，使三丁酸甘油酯成为丁酸盐递送的有效载体。
text_zh: 这种靶向释放使更多的丁酸盐分子在肠道中发挥作用，使三丁酸甘油酯成为丁酸盐递送的有效载体。
text_en: This targeted release allows more butyrate molecules to act in the intestine, making tributyrin an effective carrier for butyrate delivery.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: Transcriptomic profiling of intestinal tissue from mandarin fish after tributyrin (TB) supplementation.
statement: 对补充三丁酸甘油酯（TB）后的鳜鱼肠道组织进行了转录组分析。
text_zh: 对补充三丁酸甘油酯（TB）后的鳜鱼肠道组织进行了转录组分析。
text_en: Transcriptome analysis was performed on the intestinal tissue of mandarin fish after tributyrin (TB) supplementation.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: Histological analysis revealed significant variations in intestinal villus height (VH) and muscular thickness (MT) across different gut segments and dietary treatments
statement: 组织学分析显示，不同肠道节段和日粮处理组的肠绒毛高度（VH）和肌肉厚度（MT）存在显著差异。
text_zh: 组织学分析显示，不同肠道节段和日粮处理组的肠绒毛高度（VH）和肌肉厚度（MT）存在显著差异。
text_en: Histological analysis showed significant differences in intestinal villus height (VH) and muscle thickness (MT) among different intestinal segments and dietary treatment groups.

quote: In the foregut, no significant differences in VH were observed among the groups.
statement: 在前肠中，各组间的绒毛高度（VH）无显著差异。
text_zh: 在前肠中，各组间的绒毛高度（VH）无显著差异。
text_en: In the foregut, there was no significant difference in villus height (VH) among groups.

quote: Morphological assessment confirmed a significant increase in intestinal villus height, with the TB1 group displaying improved midgut villus architecture and the TB2 group achieving the highest villus height in the hindgut.
statement: 形态学评估证实，TB处理组的肠绒毛高度显著增加，其中TB1组中肠绒毛结构改善，TB2组后肠绒毛高度最高。
text_zh: 形态学评估证实，TB处理组的肠绒毛高度显著增加，其中TB1组中肠绒毛结构改善，TB2组后肠绒毛高度最高。
text_en: Morphological assessment confirmed that intestinal villus height significantly increased in the TB treatment group, with improved intestinal villus structure in the TB1 group and the highest hindgut villus height in the TB2 group.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: Villus height and muscular thickness are key morphological parameters indicative of its functional integrity and health status
statement: 绒毛高度和肌肉厚度是指示肠道功能完整性和健康状况的关键形态参数。
text_zh: 绒毛高度和肌肉厚度是指示肠道功能完整性和健康状况的关键形态参数。
text_en: Villus height and muscle thickness are key morphological parameters indicating intestinal functional integrity and health status.

quote: Previous research indicates that intestinal villus shortening, often associated with inflammatory conditions [ 34 ], reduces absorption efficiency by lessening digesta-epithelium contact [ 35 ], potentially explaining mandarin fish’s poor artificial feed.
statement: 既往研究表明，常与炎症相关的肠绒毛缩短通过减少食糜与上皮的接触来降低吸收效率，这可能解释了鳜鱼对人工饲料适应不良的原因。
text_zh: 既往研究表明，常与炎症相关的肠绒毛缩短通过减少食糜与上皮的接触来降低吸收效率，这可能解释了鳜鱼对人工饲料适应不良的原因。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that intestinal villus shortening, often associated with inflammation, reduces absorption efficiency by decreasing the contact between chyme and the epithelium, which may explain the poor adaptation of mandarin fish to artificial feed.

quote: In the present study, TB modulated mandarin fish intestinal morphology under artificial feeding, increasing midgut and hindgut villus height and altering muscular thickness across segments such as lower foregut muscular thickness in TB groups.
statement: 本研究中，TB在人工喂养条件下调节了鳜鱼的肠道形态，增加了中肠和后肠的绒毛高度，并改变了各段的肌肉厚度（如TB组前肠下部肌肉厚度降低）。
text_zh: 本研究中，TB在人工喂养条件下调节了鳜鱼的肠道形态，增加了中肠和后肠的绒毛高度，并改变了各段的肌肉厚度（如TB组前肠下部肌肉厚度降低）。
text_en: In this study, TB modulated the intestinal morphology of mandarin fish under artificial feeding conditions, increased the villus height of the midgut and hindgut, and altered the muscle thickness of each segment (e.g., decreased lower foregut muscle thickness in the TB group).
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: These effects align with findings in grass carp [ 7 ] and yellow catfish [ 37 ], indicating TB’s cross-species role in enhancing intestinal morphology to facilitate nutrient absorption and its potential to improve artificial feed utilization in mandarin fish.
statement: TB在鳜鱼中增强肠道形态以促进营养吸收并提高人工饲料利用率的潜力，与草鱼和黄颡鱼的研究结果一致。
text_zh: TB在鳜鱼中增强肠道形态以促进营养吸收并提高人工饲料利用率的潜力，与草鱼和黄颡鱼的研究结果一致。
text_en: The potential of TB to enhance intestinal morphology in mandarin fish to promote nutrient absorption and improve the utilization rate of artificial feed is consistent with research results on grass carp and yellow catfish.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: RNA sequencing demonstrated that dietary TB supplementation upregulates genes involved in energy metabolism ( gls2b ) and fatty acid oxidation ( cpt1b ), thereby enhancing intestinal function through increased energy production and reduced oxidative stress.
statement: 膳食TB补充剂上调了参与能量代谢和脂肪酸氧化的基因，从而通过增加能量产生和减少氧化应激来增强肠道功能。
text_zh: 膳食TB补充剂上调了参与能量代谢和脂肪酸氧化的基因，从而通过增加能量产生和减少氧化应激来增强肠道功能。
text_en: Dietary TB supplementation upregulated genes involved in energy metabolism and fatty acid oxidation, thereby enhancing intestinal function by increasing energy production and reducing oxidative stress.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: Additionally, midgut/hindgut villus shortening in the control group was more pronounced than that in a previous study [ 38 ], possibly attributable to variations in feed composition, genetics, or aquaculture conditions.
statement: 对照组中肠/后肠绒毛缩短比先前研究更明显，这可能归因于饲料成分、遗传或养殖条件的差异。
text_zh: 对照组中肠/后肠绒毛缩短比先前研究更明显，这可能归因于饲料成分、遗传或养殖条件的差异。
text_en: The shortening of intestinal/hindgut villi in the control group was more pronounced than in previous studies, which may be attributed to differences in feed composition, genetics, or farming conditions.
limitations: 对照组数据与既往研究存在差异

quote: While previous research has established that TB supplementation enhances intestinal health in fish, the complex co-expression networks modulated by TB remain relatively unexplored.
statement: 先前的研究已证实TB补充剂能增强鱼类的肠道健康。
text_zh: 先前的研究已证实TB补充剂能增强鱼类的肠道健康。
text_en: Previous studies have confirmed that TB supplements can enhance the gut health of fish.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯

quote: Genes within both modules were enriched in energy metabolism, immune regulation, and cell cycle pathways, indicating these biological processes play pivotal roles in mediating responses to TB-containing diets.
statement: 这两个模块中的基因富集在能量代谢、免疫调节和细胞周期通路中，表明这些生物过程在介导对含TB日粮的反应中起关键作用。
text_zh: 这两个模块中的基因富集在能量代谢、免疫调节和细胞周期通路中，表明这些生物过程在介导对含TB日粮的反应中起关键作用。
text_en: Genes in these two modules were enriched in energy metabolism, immune regulation, and cell cycle pathways, indicating that these biological processes play a key role in mediating the response to TB-containing diets.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯
outcome: 能量代谢、免疫调节、细胞周期

quote: By upregulating this gene, TB may supply energy for the proliferation and repair of intestinal epithelial cells and boost the intestinal antioxidant capacity.
statement: 通过上调该基因，TB可能为肠上皮细胞的增殖和修复提供能量，并增强肠道抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 通过上调该基因，TB可能为肠上皮细胞的增殖和修复提供能量，并增强肠道抗氧化能力。
text_en: By upregulating this gene, TB may provide energy for the proliferation and repair of intestinal epithelial cells and enhance intestinal antioxidant capacity.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯
outcome: 肠道细胞增殖、修复及抗氧化能力

quote: This finding is consistent with the morphological observation of increased midgut villus height in the TB1 group, offering molecular-level evidence for TB’s role in enhancing intestinal morphology.
statement: 这一发现与TB1组中肠绒毛高度增加的形态学观察结果一致，为TB改善肠道形态的作用提供了分子水平的证据。
text_zh: 这一发现与TB1组中肠绒毛高度增加的形态学观察结果一致，为TB改善肠道形态的作用提供了分子水平的证据。
text_en: This finding is consistent with the morphological observation of increased intestinal villus height in the TB1 group, providing molecular-level evidence for the effect of TB on improving intestinal morphology.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯
outcome: 肠道形态（中肠绒毛高度）

quote: The upregulation of these genes correlates with the highest hindgut villus height observed in the TB2 group.
statement: 这些基因的上调与TB2组中观察到的最高后肠绒毛高度相关。
text_zh: 这些基因的上调与TB2组中观察到的最高后肠绒毛高度相关。
text_en: The upregulation of these genes was correlated with the highest hindgut villus height observed in the TB2 group.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯
outcome: 肠道形态（后肠绒毛高度）

quote: Although short-chain fatty acids derived from TB hydrolysis do not require cpt1b for transport, and cpt1b is predominantly expressed in muscle tissues in fish [ 44 ], its upregulation in mandarin fish intestine suggests that TB may enhance mitochondrial function to boost metabolic activity, thereby providing energy for proliferating intestinal cells.
statement: 尽管TB水解产生的短链脂肪酸不需要cpt1b进行转运，且cpt1b在鱼类中主要在肌肉组织中表达，但其在鳜鱼肠道中的上调表明TB可能通过增强线粒体功能来提高代谢活性，从而为增殖的肠道细胞提供能量。
text_zh: 尽管TB水解产生的短链脂肪酸不需要cpt1b进行转运，且cpt1b在鱼类中主要在肌肉组织中表达，但其在鳜鱼肠道中的上调表明TB可能通过增强线粒体功能来提高代谢活性，从而为增殖的肠道细胞提供能量。
text_en: Although short-chain fatty acids produced by TB hydrolysis do not require cpt1b for transport, and cpt1b is mainly expressed in muscle tissue in fish, its upregulation in the intestine of Siniperca chuatsi suggests that TB may enhance metabolic activity by improving mitochondrial function, thereby providing energy for proliferating intestinal cells.
intervention_record: 饲料添加三丁酸甘油酯
outcome: 线粒体功能与代谢活性

quote: Furthermore, this finding may explain the superior gut health observed in the TB2 group—likely achieved through the synergistic action of multiple pathways, including cell proliferation, energy metabolism, and steroid synthesis, thereby comprehensively regulating intestinal function.
statement: 此外，这一发现可能解释了TB2组观察到的更优肠道健康状况——这可能是通过包括细胞增殖、能量代谢和类固醇合成在内的多种途径的协同作用实现的，从而全面调节肠道功能。
text_zh: 此外，这一发现可能解释了TB2组观察到的更优肠道健康状况——这可能是通过包括细胞增殖、能量代谢和类固醇合成在内的多种途径的协同作用实现的，从而全面调节肠道功能。
text_en: In addition, this finding may explain the better gut health observed in the TB2 group—this may be achieved through the synergistic action of multiple pathways including cell proliferation, energy metabolism and steroid synthesis, thereby comprehensively regulating gut function.

quote: W. confusa RM125 and W. cibaria SJ548 exhibited sensitivities toward a variety of pathogens, including V. harveyi , S. aureus and V. parahaemolyticus , E. coli , A. hydrophila , S. enterica , V. anguillarum , and V. alginolyticus , indicating potential probiotics.
statement: Weissella confusa RM125和Weissella cibaria SJ548对多种病原体表现出敏感性，表明其具有潜在的益生菌作用。
text_zh: Weissella confusa RM125和Weissella cibaria SJ548对多种病原体表现出敏感性，表明其具有潜在的益生菌作用。
text_en: Weissella confusa RM125 and Weissella cibaria SJ548 showed sensitivity to multiple pathogens, indicating their potential probiotic effect.
intervention: Weissella confusa RM125 and W. cibaria SJ548
intervention_record: 融合魏斯氏菌RM125与食窦魏斯氏菌SJ548

quote: our results confirmed that the transformation of feeding habit altered the structure, microbial composition and dominant bacteria in gut of mandarin fish, and provided evidence that Weissella might play a crucial role in the digestion and absorption of artificial diet in mandarin fish.
statement: 研究结果证实，食性转变改变了鳜鱼肠道的结构、微生物组成和优势菌，并提供证据表明魏斯氏菌属可能在鳜鱼人工饲料的消化吸收中发挥关键作用。
text_zh: 研究结果证实，食性转变改变了鳜鱼肠道的结构、微生物组成和优势菌，并提供证据表明魏斯氏菌属可能在鳜鱼人工饲料的消化吸收中发挥关键作用。
text_en: The results confirmed that dietary shift changed the structure, microbial composition, and dominant bacteria of the intestine in mandarin fish, and provided evidence that Weissella may play a key role in the digestion and absorption of artificial feed in mandarin fish.

quote: the higher survival rates and lower bait coefficients have suggested that the artificial feeds can be successfully used for intensive commercial culture of mandarin fish
statement: 较高的存活率和较低的饵料系数表明，人工饲料可以成功用于鳜鱼的集约化商业养殖。
text_zh: 较高的存活率和较低的饵料系数表明，人工饲料可以成功用于鳜鱼的集约化商业养殖。
text_en: Higher survival rates and lower feed conversion ratios indicate that artificial feed can be successfully used in intensive commercial farming of mandarin fish.

quote: However, food is the decisive factor of intestinal microbes, and the profound effects of change in their feeding habit on intestinal microbes of mandarin fish have not been revealed.
statement: 食物是肠道微生物的决定性因素，但改变摄食习惯对鳜鱼肠道微生物的深远影响尚未被揭示。
text_zh: 食物是肠道微生物的决定性因素，但改变摄食习惯对鳜鱼肠道微生物的深远影响尚未被揭示。
text_en: Diet is a decisive factor for gut microbiota, but the profound impact of changing feeding habits on the gut microbiota of mandarin fish has not yet been revealed.

quote: The results indicated that feeding with the artificial diet significantly increased the intestinal villi height and muscular thickness in the hindgut of mandarin fish.
statement: 结果表明，投喂人工饲料显著增加了鳜鱼后肠的绒毛高度和肌肉层厚度。
text_zh: 结果表明，投喂人工饲料显著增加了鳜鱼后肠的绒毛高度和肌肉层厚度。
text_en: The results showed that feeding artificial feed significantly increased the villus height and muscle layer thickness in the hindgut of mandarin fish.

quote: In addition, the microbiota results showed that there were significant differences of beta diversity of gut microbiota in mandarin fish fed with different diets.
statement: 此外，微生物组结果显示，不同饲料喂养的鳜鱼肠道微生物群的β多样性存在显著差异。
text_zh: 此外，微生物组结果显示，不同饲料喂养的鳜鱼肠道微生物群的β多样性存在显著差异。
text_en: In addition, microbiome results showed that there were significant differences in the beta diversity of the gut microbiota of mandarin fish fed different diets.

quote: At the genus level, feeding artificial diets significantly increased the abundance of Weissella in the mandarin fish gut.
statement: 在属水平上，投喂人工饲料显著增加了鳜鱼肠道中魏斯氏菌属（Weissella）的丰度。
text_zh: 在属水平上，投喂人工饲料显著增加了鳜鱼肠道中魏斯氏菌属（Weissella）的丰度。
text_en: At the genus level, feeding artificial feed significantly increased the abundance of Weissella in the gut of mandarin fish.

quote: more and more beneficial microbes were isolated and applied in the aquaculture not only for their nutritive effect in food utilization but also for their probiotics effects
statement: 越来越多的有益微生物被分离并应用于水产养殖中，不仅因为它们在食物利用方面的营养作用，还因为它们具有益生菌效应。
text_zh: 越来越多的有益微生物被分离并应用于水产养殖中，不仅因为它们在食物利用方面的营养作用，还因为它们具有益生菌效应。
text_en: An increasing number of beneficial microorganisms are being isolated and applied in aquaculture, not only for their nutritional role in food utilization but also for their probiotic effects.

quote: these probiotics exhibit robust antimicrobial properties, as colonized microbiota suppresses pathogens through nutrient competition and safeguard the host from infection by directly competing with pathogens via their ecological niche occupation
statement: 这些益生菌表现出强大的抗菌特性，定植的微生物群通过营养竞争抑制病原体，并通过生态位占据直接与病原体竞争以保护宿主免受感染。
text_zh: 这些益生菌表现出强大的抗菌特性，定植的微生物群通过营养竞争抑制病原体，并通过生态位占据直接与病原体竞争以保护宿主免受感染。
text_en: These probiotics exhibit strong antibacterial properties; the colonized microbiota inhibit pathogens through nutrient competition and directly compete with pathogens for niche occupation to protect the host from infection.

quote: the W. confusa N17 isolated from the gut of loach ( Misgurnus anguillicaudatus ) demonstrated significant destructive effects on Aeromonas hydrophila TH0406 and TPS
statement: 从泥鳅（Misgurnus anguillicaudatus）肠道中分离出的W. confusa N17对嗜水气单胞菌TH0406和TPS显示出显著的破坏作用。
text_zh: 从泥鳅（Misgurnus anguillicaudatus）肠道中分离出的W. confusa N17对嗜水气单胞菌TH0406和TPS显示出显著的破坏作用。
text_en: W. confusa N17 isolated from the intestine of loach (Misgurnus anguillicaudatus) showed significant destructive effects against Aeromonas hydrophila TH0406 and TPS.

quote: to enhance various aspects such as fish feeding efficiency, growth, immunity, and overall survival rates, the incorporation of probiotics into artificial feeds or water were widely used in aquaculture
statement: 为了提高鱼类的摄食效率、生长、免疫力和整体存活率等各个方面，将益生菌掺入人工饲料或水中在水产养殖中被广泛使用。
text_zh: 为了提高鱼类的摄食效率、生长、免疫力和整体存活率等各个方面，将益生菌掺入人工饲料或水中在水产养殖中被广泛使用。
text_en: To improve various aspects such as feeding efficiency, growth, immunity, and overall survival of fish, the incorporation of probiotics into artificial feed or water is widely used in aquaculture.

quote: The water quality of each tank was maintained at an optimal range of physical parameters: temperature (28.0 ± 2.0°C), pH (7.5 ± 0.5), ammonia-nitrogen (0.2 ± 0.05 mg/L), and dissolved oxygen (5.0 ± 0.5 mg/L) during the experimental period.
statement: 实验期间，每个水箱的水质物理参数（温度、pH、氨氮和溶解氧）均维持在最佳范围内。
text_zh: 实验期间，每个水箱的水质物理参数（温度、pH、氨氮和溶解氧）均维持在最佳范围内。
text_en: During the experimental period, the physical water quality parameters (temperature, pH, ammonia nitrogen, and dissolved oxygen) in each tank were maintained within optimal ranges.

quote: Afterwards, a total of 200 uniform-sized healthy fish fed with live bait fish, designated as the live fish feeding group (Control, C), and another 200 healthy mandarin fish were taken for feeding artificial diets for 25-day domestication period ( Liang et al., 2001 ; Wang et al., 2024 ), designated as the artificial feeding group (Treatment, T).
statement: 将健康鳜鱼分为两组，一组继续投喂活饵作为对照组，另一组经过25天的人工饲料驯化期后作为处理组。
text_zh: 将健康鳜鱼分为两组，一组继续投喂活饵作为对照组，另一组经过25天的人工饲料驯化期后作为处理组。
text_en: Healthy mandarin fish were divided into two groups: one group continued to be fed live bait as the control group, and the other group served as the treatment group after a 25-day artificial feed acclimation period.

quote: Subsequently, 80 uniform-sized fish from C and T groups, respectively, were randomly distributed into four tanks with 20 fish each tank, and fed with live bait and artificial diet for 8 weeks, respectively.
statement: 从对照和处理组中各选取80条大小均匀的鱼，随机分配到四个水箱中（每箱20条），分别投喂活饵和人工饲料8周。
text_zh: 从对照和处理组中各选取80条大小均匀的鱼，随机分配到四个水箱中（每箱20条），分别投喂活饵和人工饲料8周。
text_en: From the control and treatment groups, 80 fish of uniform size were selected from each group and randomly assigned to four tanks (20 fish per tank), and fed live bait and artificial feed for 8 weeks.

quote: As shown in Figures 2A – F , the structure of the gut from C and T groups exhibited regular and compact arrangement, with orderly aligned intestinal villi and intact structure.
statement: 如图2A-F所示，C组和T组的肠道结构表现出规则且紧密的排列，肠绒毛排列有序且结构完整。
text_zh: 如图2A-F所示，C组和T组的肠道结构表现出规则且紧密的排列，肠绒毛排列有序且结构完整。
text_en: As shown in Figures 2A-F, the intestinal structures of Group C and Group T exhibited regular and tight arrangements, with orderly arranged intestinal villi and intact structure.

quote: Therefore, in our study, we investigated the effect of artificial diets on the gut histology as well as the gut microbiota of mandarin fish.
statement: 本研究调查了人工饲料对鳜鱼肠道组织学和肠道微生物群的影响。
text_zh: 本研究调查了人工饲料对鳜鱼肠道组织学和肠道微生物群的影响。
text_en: This study investigated the effects of artificial feed on the intestinal histology and gut microbiota of mandarin fish.
outcome: 肠道健康与微生物组成

quote: Most importantly, we aimed to isolate and obtain potential probiotics adapted to the gut environment of mandarin fish that were fed artificial diets.
statement: 研究旨在分离和获取适应于摄食人工饲料的鳜鱼肠道环境的潜在益生菌。
text_zh: 研究旨在分离和获取适应于摄食人工饲料的鳜鱼肠道环境的潜在益生菌。
text_en: The study aimed to isolate and obtain potential probiotics adapted to the gut environment of mandarin fish fed artificial feed.

quote: Fish were sacrificed, and all efforts were exerted to minimize suffering.
statement: 鱼类被处死，并尽一切努力减少痛苦。
text_zh: 鱼类被处死，并尽一切努力减少痛苦。
text_en: Fish were killed, and every effort was made to minimize suffering.

quote: A total of 600 healthy mandarin fish (weight: 12 ± 0.5 g) were stocked into indoor canvas tanks for 7 days.
statement: 将600条健康的鳜鱼（体重12±0.5克）放入室内帆布池中养殖7天。
text_zh: 将600条健康的鳜鱼（体重12±0.5克）放入室内帆布池中养殖7天。
text_en: 600 healthy mandarin fish (body weight 12±0.5 g) were placed in indoor canvas pools for 7 days.

quote: During the acclimation period, the fish were fed twice a day (at 06:00 and 18.00 h) with live India mrigal ( Cirrhinus mrigala ) as bait.
statement: 在驯化期间，每天两次（06:00和18:00）投喂活的印度鲮作为饵料。
text_zh: 在驯化期间，每天两次（06:00和18:00）投喂活的印度鲮作为饵料。
text_en: During the acclimation period, live Indian carp were fed as bait twice daily (06:00 and 18:00).

quote: Notably, domestication and cultivation of mandarin fish by artificial diet feeding can achieve great profitability by reducing the demand for live bait fish.
statement: 通过人工饲料喂养对鳜鱼进行驯化和养殖可以通过减少活饵鱼的需求来实现巨大的盈利能力。
text_zh: 通过人工饲料喂养对鳜鱼进行驯化和养殖可以通过减少活饵鱼的需求来实现巨大的盈利能力。
text_en: Domesticating and farming mandarin fish through artificial feed can achieve huge profitability by reducing the demand for live bait fish.

quote: Still, the effects of artificial diet on the digestive system of domesticated mandarin fish remains incompletely elucidated.
statement: 尽管如此，人工饲料对驯化鳜鱼消化系统的影响仍未完全阐明。
text_zh: 尽管如此，人工饲料对驯化鳜鱼消化系统的影响仍未完全阐明。
text_en: Nevertheless, the effects of artificial feed on the digestive system of domesticated mandarin fish have not been fully elucidated.

quote: Increasing studies have discovered that dietary modifications can lead to shifts in the gut microecology of aquatic animals ( Ma et al., 2021 ; Wei et al., 2023 ; Shi et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024 ).
statement: 越来越多的研究发现，饮食改变会导致水生动物肠道微生态的变化。
text_zh: 越来越多的研究发现，饮食改变会导致水生动物肠道微生态的变化。
text_en: More and more studies have found that dietary changes lead to changes in the gut microbiota of aquatic animals.

quote: The heights of intestinal villi and thickness of the intestinal muscular in Group C were gradually decreased from foregut to hindgut, but those were incrementally increased in Group T ( Figures 2G , H ).
statement: 在活饵喂养组（C组）中，肠绒毛高度和肠道肌肉厚度从前肠到后肠逐渐降低，而在人工饲料喂养组（T组）中则逐渐增加。
text_zh: 在活饵喂养组（C组）中，肠绒毛高度和肠道肌肉厚度从前肠到后肠逐渐降低，而在人工饲料喂养组（T组）中则逐渐增加。
text_en: In the live bait feeding group (Group C), intestinal villus height and intestinal muscle thickness gradually decreased from the foregut to the hindgut, whereas in the artificial feed feeding group (Group T) they gradually increased.

quote: Compared to Group C, the heights of intestinal villi were significantly reduced in the foregut and midgut ( p 0.05), but significantly elevated in the hindgut of Group T ( p 0.05) ( Figure 2G ).
statement: 与活饵喂养组相比，人工饲料喂养组的前肠和中肠肠绒毛高度显著降低，但后肠肠绒毛高度显著升高。
text_zh: 与活饵喂养组相比，人工饲料喂养组的前肠和中肠肠绒毛高度显著降低，但后肠肠绒毛高度显著升高。
text_en: Compared to the live bait feeding group, the intestinal villus height in the foregut and midgut of the artificial feed feeding group was significantly lower, but the intestinal villus height in the hindgut was significantly higher.

quote: The thickness of intestinal muscular was significantly decreased in foregut, but increased in hindgut of Group T, compared with Group C ( p 0.05) ( Figure 2H ).
statement: 与活饵喂养组相比，人工饲料喂养组的肠道肌肉厚度在前肠显著降低，但在后肠增加。
text_zh: 与活饵喂养组相比，人工饲料喂养组的肠道肌肉厚度在前肠显著降低，但在后肠增加。
text_en: Compared to the live bait feeding group, the intestinal muscle thickness in the artificial feed feeding group was significantly reduced in the foregut but increased in the hindgut.

quote: Significant differences were observed between the gut bacterial communities of mandarin fish fed live bait and those fed an artificial diet ( p 0.05) ( Figure 3C ).
statement: 饲喂活饵和人工饲料的鳜鱼肠道菌群存在显著差异。
text_zh: 饲喂活饵和人工饲料的鳜鱼肠道菌群存在显著差异。
text_en: There are significant differences in the gut microbiota of mandarin fish fed live bait and artificial feed.
intervention: Live bait vs artificial feed comparison

quote: Distinct community structures of gut microbiota were observed in mandarin fish fed with live bait and artificial diet.
statement: 在饲喂活饵和人工饲料的鳜鱼中观察到不同的肠道微生物群落结构。
text_zh: 在饲喂活饵和人工饲料的鳜鱼中观察到不同的肠道微生物群落结构。
text_en: Different gut microbial community structures were observed in mandarin fish fed live bait and artificial feed.
intervention: Live bait vs artificial feed comparison

quote: PICRUSt2 analyses revealed that, despite being from different feeding groups (C and T) of the mandarin fish exhibited similar gene functions
statement: PICRUSt2分析显示，尽管来自不同的投喂组（C和T），鳜鱼的肠道微生物群表现出相似的基因功能。
text_zh: PICRUSt2分析显示，尽管来自不同的投喂组（C和T），鳜鱼的肠道微生物群表现出相似的基因功能。
text_en: PICRUSt2 analysis showed that, despite being from different feeding groups (C and T), the gut microbiota of mandarin fish exhibited similar gene functions.

quote: Since mandarin fish are adapted to digesting live bait, we speculated that transformation of feeding habit in mandarin fish would have an impact on the structure and microbiota composition of gut.
statement: 由于鳜鱼适应消化活饵，作者推测改变鳜鱼的摄食习惯会影响肠道结构和微生物群组成。
text_zh: 由于鳜鱼适应消化活饵，作者推测改变鳜鱼的摄食习惯会影响肠道结构和微生物群组成。
text_en: Since mandarin fish are adapted to digesting live bait, the authors hypothesized that changing the feeding habits of mandarin fish would affect gut structure and microbiota composition.
outcome: 肠道结构与微生物群组成

quote: Previous studies have shown that feeding mandarin fish artificial diets may cause intestinal villi to shrink and rupture ( Huang et al., 2023 ).
statement: 先前的研究表明，给鳜鱼投喂人工饲料可能导致肠绒毛萎缩和破裂。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，给鳜鱼投喂人工饲料可能导致肠绒毛萎缩和破裂。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that feeding mandarin fish artificial feed may lead to intestinal villus atrophy and rupture.

quote: In the present study, the results of histological observation in gut revealed a significant decrease in intestinal villi height and muscle thickness in the foregut and midgut of mandarin fish fed artificial diets, consistent with the results reported by Chen et al. (2021) .
statement: 本研究的组织学观察结果显示，投喂人工饲料的鳜鱼前肠和中肠的肠绒毛高度和肌肉厚度显著降低。
text_zh: 本研究的组织学观察结果显示，投喂人工饲料的鳜鱼前肠和中肠的肠绒毛高度和肌肉厚度显著降低。
text_en: Histological observations in this study showed that the intestinal villus height and muscle thickness of the foregut and midgut of mandarin fish fed artificial feed were significantly reduced.
outcome: 肠道形态（绒毛高度、肌肉厚度）

quote: Furthermore, the muscle thickness of intestine and intestinal villi height showed a different tendency in the foregut, midgut, and hindgut, suggesting adaptive changes in the gut structure of mandarin fish in response to artificial diets for improved digestion and absorption.
statement: 此外，肠道肌肉厚度和肠绒毛高度在前肠、中肠和后肠表现出不同的趋势，表明鳜鱼肠道结构对人工饲料产生了适应性变化以改善消化和吸收。
text_zh: 此外，肠道肌肉厚度和肠绒毛高度在前肠、中肠和后肠表现出不同的趋势，表明鳜鱼肠道结构对人工饲料产生了适应性变化以改善消化和吸收。
text_en: In addition, intestinal muscle thickness and villus height showed different trends in the foregut, midgut, and hindgut, indicating that the intestinal structure of Siniperca chuatsi underwent adaptive changes to artificial feed to improve digestion and absorption.

quote: Histological observation of the gut from S. chuatsi was conducted based on the method described in Xu et al. (2022) . Briefly, the gut tissue underwent a series of procedures including dehydration with alcohol, immersion in paraffin, and staining with hematoxylin and eosin (H E). The gut tissue morphology was then observed and photographed under a microscope (BX40F4, Olympus, Tokyo, Japan). ImageJ software was utilized to measure the intestinal villus height and the intestinal muscular thickness.
statement: 基于Xu等人(2022)描述的方法对鳜鱼(S. chuatsi)肠道进行组织学观察，通过酒精脱水、石蜡包埋和HE染色处理肠道组织，在显微镜下观察并拍照，并使用ImageJ软件测量肠绒毛高度和肠肌层厚度。
text_zh: 基于Xu等人(2022)描述的方法对鳜鱼(S. chuatsi)肠道进行组织学观察，通过酒精脱水、石蜡包埋和HE染色处理肠道组织，在显微镜下观察并拍照，并使用ImageJ软件测量肠绒毛高度和肠肌层厚度。
text_en: Histological observation of the intestine of mandarin fish (S. chuatsi) was performed based on the method described by Xu et al. (2022). Intestinal tissues were processed through alcohol dehydration, paraffin embedding, and HE staining, observed and photographed under a microscope, and intestinal villus height and intestinal muscular layer thickness were measured using ImageJ software.

quote: As illustrated in Table 1 , W. confusa RM125 exhibited high sensitivity toward V. harveyi , moderate sensitivity toward S. aureus and V. parahaemolyticus , and low sensitivity toward E. coli , A. hydrophila , S. enterica , V. anguillarum , and V. alginolyticus .
statement: W. confusa RM125对V. harveyi表现出高敏感性，对S. aureus和V. parahaemolyticus表现出中等敏感性，对E. coli、A. hydrophila、S. enterica、V. anguillarum和V. alginolyticus表现出低敏感性。
text_en: W. confusa RM125对V. harveyi表现出高敏感性，对S. aureus和V. parahaemolyticus表现出中等敏感性，对E. coli、A. hydrophila、S. enterica、V. anguillarum和V. alginolyticus表现出低敏感性。

quote: At the genus level, the abundance of Weissella (67.70%) was significantly increased in the artificial feeding group, compared with the group fed with live bait, suggesting that the colonization of Weissella may be involved in the transformation of feeding habits in mandarin fish during domestication.
statement: 在属水平上，人工投喂组中Weissella的丰度（67.70%）显著高于活饵投喂组，表明Weissella的定植可能参与鳜鱼驯化过程中摄食习性的转变。
text_zh: 在属水平上，人工投喂组中Weissella的丰度（67.70%）显著高于活饵投喂组，表明Weissella的定植可能参与鳜鱼驯化过程中摄食习性的转变。
text_en: At the genus level, the abundance of Weissella in the artificial feeding group (67.70%) was significantly higher than that in the live bait feeding group, indicating that the colonization of Weissella may be involved in the shift in feeding habits during the domestication of Chinese perch.
outcome: 肠道菌群组成与摄食习性适应

quote: Moreover, the analysis using PICRUSt2 revealed that the abundance of metabolic pathways, biosynthesis of secondary metabolites, microbial metabolism in diverse environments, and carbon metabolism in mandarin fish fed artificial diet were more abundant than those in the live fish bait.
statement: 使用PICRUSt2分析显示，与活饵相比，投喂人工饲料的鳜鱼肠道微生物中与代谢途径、次级代谢产物生物合成、不同环境中的微生物代谢以及碳代谢相关的通路丰度更高。
text_zh: 使用PICRUSt2分析显示，与活饵相比，投喂人工饲料的鳜鱼肠道微生物中与代谢途径、次级代谢产物生物合成、不同环境中的微生物代谢以及碳代谢相关的通路丰度更高。
text_en: Analysis using PICRUSt2 showed that the abundance of pathways related to metabolism, biosynthesis of secondary metabolites, microbial metabolism in diverse environments, and carbon metabolism in the gut microbiota of mandarin fish fed artificial feed was higher compared to those fed live bait.

quote: Taken together, these findings suggest that mandarin fish possessed the capability to consume artificial feeds, break down and metabolize substantial quantities of amino acids, proteins, fats, and other essential nutrients present in the artificial diet.
statement: 综合来看，这些发现表明鳜鱼具备摄食人工饲料并分解代谢其中大量氨基酸、蛋白质、脂肪及其他必需营养素的能力。
text_zh: 综合来看，这些发现表明鳜鱼具备摄食人工饲料并分解代谢其中大量氨基酸、蛋白质、脂肪及其他必需营养素的能力。
text_en: Taken together, these findings indicate that mandarin fish are capable of consuming artificial feed and metabolizing the large amounts of amino acids, proteins, fats, and other essential nutrients within it.

text_en: The effect of short-term artificial feed acclimation on the expression of oxidative stress-related genes.

statement: 人工饲料喂养导致鳜鱼前肠和中肠的肠绒毛高度和肌肉厚度显著降低，表明肠道结构发生了适应性变化。
text_zh: 人工饲料喂养导致鳜鱼前肠和中肠的肠绒毛高度和肌肉厚度显著降低，表明肠道结构发生了适应性变化。
text_en: Artificial feed feeding led to a significant decrease in intestinal villus height and muscle thickness in the foregut and midgut of mandarin fish, indicating adaptive changes in gut structure.

quote: The artificial diet significantly affected the diversity and abundance of gut microbiota in mandarin fish, with a significant increase in the abundance of Weissella (67.70%), indicating that the colonization of Weissella might be involved in the domestication and feeding habit transformation of mandarin fish.
statement: 人工饲料显著影响了鳜鱼肠道微生物群的多样性和丰度，其中魏斯氏菌属（Weissella）的丰度显著增加至67.70%，表明该菌的定植可能参与了鳜鱼的驯化和摄食习惯转变。
text_zh: 人工饲料显著影响了鳜鱼肠道微生物群的多样性和丰度，其中魏斯氏菌属（Weissella）的丰度显著增加至67.70%，表明该菌的定植可能参与了鳜鱼的驯化和摄食习惯转变。
text_en: Artificial feed significantly affected the diversity and abundance of the gut microbiota of mandarin fish, with the abundance of Weissella increasing significantly to 67.70%, indicating that colonization by this bacterium may be involved in the domestication and shift in feeding habits of mandarin fish.

quote: The digestive system of mandarin fish ( Siniperca chuatsi ) can adapt to domestication by feeding with artificial diet.
statement: 鳜鱼的消化系统可以通过投喂人工饲料适应驯化。
text_zh: 鳜鱼的消化系统可以通过投喂人工饲料适应驯化。
text_en: The digestive system of mandarin fish can adapt to domestication through feeding artificial feed.

quote: Two strains W. confusa RM125 and W. cibaria SJ548 identified in our screening displayed a high potential for use as probiotics in aquaculture as they inhibited common aquaculture pathogens with a broad spectrum of bacteriostatic properties.
statement: 本研究中筛选出的W. confusa RM125和W. cibaria SJ548两株菌因能抑制常见水产养殖病原体且具有广谱抑菌特性，显示出作为水产养殖益生菌的高潜力。
text_zh: 本研究中筛选出的W. confusa RM125和W. cibaria SJ548两株菌因能抑制常见水产养殖病原体且具有广谱抑菌特性，显示出作为水产养殖益生菌的高潜力。
text_en: The two strains W. confusa RM125 and W. cibaria SJ548 screened in this study show high potential as aquaculture probiotics because they can inhibit common aquaculture pathogens and have broad-spectrum antibacterial properties.

population.system: fed an artificial diet (人工饲料喂养)

intervention: Weissella confusa RM125 and W. cibaria SJ548
intervention_record: 融合魏斯氏菌RM125与食窦魏斯氏菌SJ548

quote: Both W. confusa RM125 and W. cibaria SJ548 could effectively suppress a range of widespread bacteria in aquatic environments, including E. coli , A. hydrophila , S. aureus , S. enterica , and V. anguillarum , as well as those distributed specifically in seawater habitats, such as V. harveyi , V. parahaemolyticus , and V. alginolyticus , revealing a broad spectrum of bacteriostatic properties of these two strains.
statement: W. confusa RM125和W. cibaria SJ548均能有效抑制水生环境中广泛存在的细菌（包括大肠杆菌、嗜水气单胞菌等）以及海水栖息地特有的细菌（如哈维氏弧菌等），揭示了这两株菌的广谱抑菌特性。
text_zh: W. confusa RM125和W. cibaria SJ548均能有效抑制水生环境中广泛存在的细菌（包括大肠杆菌、嗜水气单胞菌等）以及海水栖息地特有的细菌（如哈维氏弧菌等），揭示了这两株菌的广谱抑菌特性。
text_en: Both W. confusa RM125 and W. cibaria SJ548 can effectively inhibit bacteria widely present in aquatic environments (including Escherichia coli, Aeromonas hydrophila, etc.) as well as bacteria specific to marine habitats (such as Vibrio harveyi, etc.), revealing the broad-spectrum antibacterial properties of these two strains.

population.system: fed an artificial diet (人工饲料喂养)

intervention: Weissella confusa RM125 and W. cibaria SJ548
intervention_record: 融合魏斯氏菌RM125与食窦魏斯氏菌SJ548

quote: The similar broad inhibitory spectrum was found in W. cibaria HN05 and W. cibaria C-10 from Pacific white shrimp ( Litopenaeus vannamei ) and crucian carp ( Carassius auratus ), respectively, suggesting the probiotic potential of Weissella for aquaculture ( Huy et al., 2020 ; Zhu et al., 2022 ).
statement: 在太平洋白虾和鲫鱼中分离出的W. cibaria HN05和W. cibaria C-10也发现了类似的广谱抑制范围，这表明了Weissella属在水产养殖中的益生菌潜力。
text_zh: 在太平洋白虾和鲫鱼中分离出的W. cibaria HN05和W. cibaria C-10也发现了类似的广谱抑制范围，这表明了Weissella属在水产养殖中的益生菌潜力。
text_en: Similar broad-spectrum inhibitory ranges were also found in W. cibaria HN05 and W. cibaria C-10 isolated from Pacific white shrimp and crucian carp, indicating the probiotic potential of the genus Weissella in aquaculture.

quote: Furthermore, several studies have found an enhancement immunity and improvement of feed conversion rate in aquatic animals by adding Weissella to the artificial diets, including crucian carp ( Carassius auratus ) ( Zhu et al., 2022 ) and rainbow trout ( Oncorhynchus mykiss ) ( Kahyani et al., 2021 ).
statement: 此外，多项研究发现，在人工饲料中添加Weissella可增强水生动物（包括鲫鱼和虹鳟）的免疫力并提高饲料转化率。
text_zh: 此外，多项研究发现，在人工饲料中添加Weissella可增强水生动物（包括鲫鱼和虹鳟）的免疫力并提高饲料转化率。
text_en: In addition, multiple studies have found that adding Weissella to artificial feed enhances the immunity of aquatic animals (including crucian carp and rainbow trout) and improves feed conversion rates.

quote: 쏘가리 치어의 일일사료섭취율, 일일단백질섭취율, 단백질효율, 비만도, 간중량지수 및 내장중량지수는 사육수온에 따른 유의적인 차이는 나타나지 않았다(P>0.05).
statement: 실험된 수온 범위 내에서 쏘가리 치어의 일일사료섭취율, 일일단백질섭취율, 단백질효율, 비만도, 간중량지수 및 내장중량지수는 유의한 차이가 없었다.
text_en: 실험된 수온 범위 내에서 쏘가리 치어의 일일사료섭취율, 일일단백질섭취율, 단백질효율, 비만도, 간중량지수 및 내장중량지수는 유의한 차이가 없었다.

quote: 본 연구에서 설정된 수온 범위 내에서 수온이 증가할수록 높아져 차이를 보였으나, 일일사료섭취율, 일단백질섭취율 및 단백질효율은 사육수온에 따른 차이를 보이지 않았다.
statement: 본 연구의 수온 범위에서 성장과 사료효율은 수온 증가에 따라 향상되었으나, 섭취율과 단백질 효율은 변화하지 않았다.
text_en: 본 연구의 수온 범위에서 성장과 사료효율은 수온 증가에 따라 향상되었으나, 섭취율과 단백질 효율은 변화하지 않았다.

quote: 본 연구에서 사료섭취율이 기존의 연구 결과와는 달리 사육수온에 따라 차이를 보이지 않은 것은 어종의 서식특성 등에 의한 것으로 판단된다.
statement: 사료섭취율이 수온에 따라 변하지 않은 이유는 담수어류의 높은 수온 내성 등 서식 특성에 기인한 것으로 추정된다.
text_en: 사료섭취율이 수온에 따라 변하지 않은 이유는 담수어류의 높은 수온 내성 등 서식 특성에 기인한 것으로 추정된다.

quote: 하지만, 적정 성장을 위한 수온보다 더 높아지면 어류의 사료섭취가 감소되는 등 부작용이 초래된다(Maccarthy et al., 1998).
statement: 적정 성장 수온을 초과하면 어류의 사료 섭취가 감소하는 등의 부작용이 발생할 수 있다.
text_en: 적정 성장 수온을 초과하면 어류의 사료 섭취가 감소하는 등의 부작용이 발생할 수 있다.

quote: 쏘가리가 살아 움직이는 작은 어류만을 먹는 강한 육식성으로 인하여 사료 공급이 어려워 다양한 연구가 이루어지지 못했기 때문이다.
statement: 쏘가리는 살아있는 작은 어류만 섭취하는 강한 육식성 때문에 사료 공급이 어려워 관련 연구가 제한되었다.
text_en: 쏘가리는 살아있는 작은 어류만 섭취하는 강한 육식성 때문에 사료 공급이 어려워 관련 연구가 제한되었다.

quote: 잉어나 붕어의 자어를 어린 쏘가리에게 먹이로 공급하면서 3-4 cm까지 키운 후, 방류사업에 참여하고, 나머지는 살아있는 먹이 공급이 어려워지면 굶겨 죽이는 실정이다.
statement: 현재 양식장에서는 잉어 또는 붕어 자어를 먹이로 공급하며, 살아있는 먹이 확보가 어려울 경우 굶겨 죽이는 방식이 사용되고 있다.
text_en: 현재 양식장에서는 잉어 또는 붕어 자어를 먹이로 공급하며, 살아있는 먹이 확보가 어려울 경우 굶겨 죽이는 방식이 사용되고 있다.
intervention: Starvation treatment combined with live bait feeding
intervention_record: 饥饿处理结合活饵投喂

quote: 하천에 서식하는 살아있는 어류를 불법으로 포획하여 쏘가리에게 공급하면서 치어를 6 cm 정도까지 키운 후에 냉동어류를 공급하여 양성하는 양어장도 있다.
statement: 일부 양어장은 불법 포획한 살아있는 어류를 공급하다가 치어가 6cm 정도 자라면 냉동어류로 전환하여 양성한다.
text_en: 일부 양어장은 불법 포획한 살아있는 어류를 공급하다가 치어가 6cm 정도 자라면 냉동어류로 전환하여 양성한다.
intervention: Feeding illegally caught live and frozen fish
intervention_record: 投喂非法捕捞活鱼和冷冻鱼

quote: 이러한 양식방법은 하천의 자원을 고갈시키고, 냉동어류의 공급 불안정, 냉동보관에 따른 경영비 상승, 산패에 따른 질병발생 등의 여러 가지 문제점을 가지고 있다.
statement: 기존 양식 방법은 자원 고갈, 공급 불안정, 비용 상승 및 산패로 인한 질병 발생 등 문제를 야기한다.
text_en: 기존 양식 방법은 자원 고갈, 공급 불안정, 비용 상승 및 산패로 인한 질병 발생 등 문제를 야기한다.

quote: 최근 충청북도내수면연구소에서 쏘가리를 배합사료로 사육하는 연구에 성공하면서(Kim, 2015), 이를 기반으로 하여 현재 배합사료 개발을 위한 실험을 수행하고 있으며, 양성을 위한 사육도 가능해져 쏘가리 양식산업화가 앞당겨 질 것으로 전망된다.
statement: 충청북도내수면연구소의 배합사료 사육 성공 사례를 바탕으로 배합사료 개발 및 양성 기술 확립이 진행 중이다.
text_en: 충청북도내수면연구소의 배합사료 사육 성공 사례를 바탕으로 배합사료 개발 및 양성 기술 확립이 진행 중이다.

quote: This study was conducted to investigate the effects of different water temperatures on growth, survival, biochemical composition, and blood physiological parameters of juvenile mandarin fish Siniperca scherzeri.
statement: 本研究旨在探讨不同水温对鳜鱼幼鱼生长、存活率、生化组成和血液生理参数的影响。
text_zh: 本研究旨在探讨不同水温对鳜鱼幼鱼生长、存活率、生化组成和血液生理参数的影响。
text_en: This study aims to investigate the effects of different water temperatures on the growth, survival rate, biochemical composition, and blood physiological parameters of juvenile mandarin fish.

quote: Feed-trained juvenile fish were subjected to four water temperatures (20, 23, 26 and 29℃) with two replicate groups.
statement: 经过摄食训练的幼鱼被置于四个水温组（20、23、26和29℃）中，每组有两个重复。
text_zh: 经过摄食训练的幼鱼被置于四个水温组（20、23、26和29℃）中，每组有两个重复。
text_en: Juvenile fish that had undergone feeding training were placed in four water temperature groups (20, 23, 26 and 29°C), with two replicates per group.

quote: The fish were fed to apparent satiation twice daily using a formulated diet containing 55% crude protein and 6% crude lipid.
statement: 鱼类每天两次投喂至表观饱食，使用含55%粗蛋白和6%粗脂的配方饲料。
text_zh: 鱼类每天两次投喂至表观饱食，使用含55%粗蛋白和6%粗脂的配方饲料。
text_en: Fish were fed to apparent satiation twice daily using a formulated diet containing 55% crude protein and 6% crude lipid.

quote: After the 8-week feeding trial, survival was >96% in all groups.
statement: 经过8周的饲养试验后，所有组的存活率均超过96%。
text_zh: 经过8周的饲养试验后，所有组的存活率均超过96%。
text_en: After an 8-week feeding trial, the survival rate in all groups exceeded 96%.

quote: Weight gain and feed efficiency of fish reared at 26 and 29℃ were higher than those reared at 20℃.
statement: 在26℃和29℃下饲养的鱼，其增重和饲料效率高于在20℃下饲养的鱼。
text_zh: 在26℃和29℃下饲养的鱼，其增重和饲料效率高于在20℃下饲养的鱼。
text_en: Fish reared at 26°C and 29°C had higher weight gain and feed efficiency than fish reared at 20°C.

quote: The protein efficiency ratio, daily feed intake, and whole body proximate composition were not affected by water temperature.
statement: 蛋白质效率比、日摄食量和全身近似组成不受水温影响。
text_zh: 蛋白质效率比、日摄食量和全身近似组成不受水温影响。
text_en: Protein efficiency ratio, daily feed intake, and whole-body proximate composition were not affected by water temperature.

quote: These results indicate that a suitable water temperature range for optimal growth and feed efficiency of juvenile mandarin fish is 26-29℃ under these experimental conditions.
statement: 结果表明，在这些实验条件下，鳜鱼幼鱼最佳生长和饲料效率的适宜水温范围为26-29℃。
text_zh: 结果表明，在这些实验条件下，鳜鱼幼鱼最佳生长和饲料效率的适宜水温范围为26-29℃。
text_en: The results showed that, under these experimental conditions, the suitable water temperature range for optimal growth and feed efficiency of juvenile mandarin fish was 26-29°C.

quote: Total protein과 GOT 함량은 수온 20℃ 실험구가 다른 수온 실험구보다 유의하게 높은 값을 나타내었다 (P<0.05).
statement: 수온 20℃에서 사육한 쏘가리의 혈중 Total protein 및 GOT 함량이 다른 수온 구보다 유의하게 높게 나타났다.
text_en: 수온 20℃에서 사육한 쏘가리의 혈중 Total protein 및 GOT 함량이 다른 수온 구보다 유의하게 높게 나타났다.
counterevidence: GOT 상승은 저온 스트레스 또는 대사 부작용의 가능성을 시사한다.

quote: 이상의 결과로부터, 쏘가리는 온수성 담수어종으로 분류되어야 할 것으로 보이며, 본 실험 조건에서 쏘가리 치어의 최적성장 및 사료효율을 위한 사육수온은 26-29℃가 적합할 것으로 판단된다.
statement: 실험 결과에 따라 쏘가리는 온수성 어종으로 분류되며, 치어의 최적 성장과 사료 효율을 위한 적정 사육 수온은 26-29℃로 판단된다.
text_en: 실험 결과에 따라 쏘가리는 온수성 어종으로 분류되며, 치어의 최적 성장과 사료 효율을 위한 적정 사육 수온은 26-29℃로 판단된다.

quote: 리대사에 가장 큰 영향을 미치는 요인으로 알려져 있으며(Brett and Groves, 1979; Jobling, 1997; Johnston, 2006), 사료섭취에도 직접적인 영향을 미쳐 사료효율 및 사료이용성에 영향을 주는 중요한 요소이다(Yamamoto et al., 2007; Bogevik et al., 2010).
statement: 수온은 어류의 대사, 사료 섭취, 사료 효율 및 이용성에 영향을 미치는 중요한 요인이다.
text_en: 수온은 어류의 대사, 사료 섭취, 사료 효율 및 이용성에 영향을 미치는 중요한 요인이다.

quote: 대상 어류에 적합한 수온에서는 사료섭취, 소화 및 사료의 영양이용성이 향상되지만(Bogevik et al., 2010), 적합한 수온 이하에서는 사료 섭취 및 성장의 감소되고(Bendiksen et al., 2002), 효소활성 및 삼투압조절 변화가 초래된다(Mccormick et al., 1996).
statement: 적합한 수온에서는 사료 섭취와 소화가 개선되나, 낮은 수온에서는 섭취와 성장이 감소하고 효소 활성 및 삼투압 조절에 변화가 생긴다.
text_en: 적합한 수온에서는 사료 섭취와 소화가 개선되나, 낮은 수온에서는 섭취와 성장이 감소하고 효소 활성 및 삼투압 조절에 변화가 생긴다.

quote: 반면에 너무 높은 수온에서 사육되는 어류는 대사장애 및 먹이섭취 감소 등의 부작용이 초래된다(Sun and Chen, 2009; Bermudes et al., 2010).
statement: 너무 높은 수온은 어류에게 대사 장애와 먹이 섭취 감소와 같은 부작용을 유발한다.
text_en: 너무 높은 수온은 어류에게 대사 장애와 먹이 섭취 감소와 같은 부작용을 유발한다.

quote: 실험어로 충청북도내수면연구소에서 종묘생산된 쏘가리를 배합사료에 순치시켜 사육하다가 평균체중 11.4±0.15 g의 치어를 사용하였다.
statement: 실험에 사용된 쏘가리는 배합사료에 순치(적응) 과정을 거쳤다.
text_en: 실험에 사용된 쏘가리는 배합사료에 순치(적응) 과정을 거쳤다.

quote: 사육수온은 자동온도조절기를 각각의 순환여과사육시스템에 설치하여 조절하였다.
statement: 사육 수온은 자동 온도 조절기가 설치된 순환 여과 시스템을 통해 제어되었다.
text_en: 사육 수온은 자동 온도 조절기가 설치된 순환 여과 시스템을 통해 제어되었다.

quote: 각 수온별로 2반복으로 원형 FRP 수조(200 L)에 실험어를 수용하여 1일 2회 만복으로 실험사료를 8주간 공급하였다.
statement: 실험어는 하루 두 번 만복(자유 섭취) 방식으로 8주간 사료가 공급되었다.
text_en: 실험어는 하루 두 번 만복(자유 섭취) 방식으로 8주간 사료가 공급되었다.

quote: 산소 공급을 위해 에어스톤을 설치하였다.
statement: 용존 산소 공급을 위해 에어스톤이 사용되었다.
text_en: 용존 산소 공급을 위해 에어스톤이 사용되었다.

quote: 어체 측정은 사육실험 시작시와 종료시에 측정 전일 절식시킨 후 tricaine methanesulfonate (MS 222, Sigma, St. Louis, MO, USA) 100 ppm 수용액에 마취시켜 실험어의 무게를 측정하였다.
statement: 체중 측정을 위해 측정 전날 절식을 시키고 MS-222로 마취 처리를 하였다.
text_en: 체중 측정을 위해 측정 전날 절식을 시키고 MS-222로 마취 처리를 하였다.

quote: 사육수온에 따른 체조성의 변화는 어종마다 다르게 나타나므로 대상어종마다 수온변화에 대한 영향을 각각 평가할 필요가 있는 것으로 알려져 있다(Cui and Wootton, 1988).
statement: 사육 수온에 따른 체조성 변화는 어종마다 다르므로 각 어종별로 수온 영향 평가를 해야 한다.
text_en: 사육 수온에 따른 체조성 변화는 어종마다 다르므로 각 어종별로 수온 영향 평가를 해야 한다.

quote: Peres and Oliva-Teles (1999)와 Moreira et al. (2008)는 유럽산 배스(Dicentrarchus labrax)를 대상으로 수온별 사육실험에서 두 실험 모두 전어체에 유의한 차이를 나타내었으나, 서로 다른 경향을 보였다.
statement: 유럽산 배스에서 수온별 사육실험 결과 전어체에 유의한 차이가 있었으나 두 연구 간 경향이 달랐다.
text_en: 유럽산 배스에서 수온별 사육실험 결과 전어체에 유의한 차이가 있었으나 두 연구 간 경향이 달랐다.

quote: Total cholesterol, GPT, ALP, bilirubin 및 albumin 함량은 모든 실험구간 유의한 차이가 나타나지 않았다.
statement: 본 실험에서 총 콜레스테롤, GPT, ALP, 빌리루빈 및 알부민 함량은 모든 수온 구간에서 유의한 차이가 없었다.
text_en: 본 실험에서 총 콜레스테롤, GPT, ALP, 빌리루빈 및 알부민 함량은 모든 수온 구간에서 유의한 차이가 없었다.

quote:
무게 측정 후 실험수조마다 5마리씩 sampling하여 비만도,
간중량지수 및 내장중량지수를 구하였다.
statement: 각 실험수조에서 5마리를 샘플링하여 비만도, 간중량지수 및 내장중량지수를 계산하였다.
text_en: 각 실험수조에서 5마리를 샘플링하여 비만도, 간중량지수 및 내장중량지수를 계산하였다.

quote:
혈장성분의 변화를 조사하기 위해 각 실험수조 쏘가리 치어
5마리씩 무작위로 추출하여 헤파린이 처리된 1 mL 주사기를
사용하여 실험어의 미부 혈관에서 채혈하였다.
statement: 혈장 성분 변화 조사를 위해 각 수조의 쏘가리 치어 5마리를 무작위 추출하여 미부 혈관에서 채혈하였다.
text_en: 혈장 성분 변화 조사를 위해 각 수조의 쏘가리 치어 5마리를 무작위 추출하여 미부 혈관에서 채혈하였다.
outcome: 스트레스 반응 및 건강 지표 모니터링

quote:
8주간의 사육실험 후, 성장 및 사료이용성을 Table 2와 3에
각각 나타내었다. 사육실험기간 동안의 생존율은96.3% 이상
으로 나타났으며, 모든 실험구간에 통계적인 차이는 없었다
(P>0.05).
statement: 8주간 사육 실험 결과 생존율은 96.3% 이상이었으며, 실험군 간 통계적 차이는 없었다.
text_en: 8주간 사육 실험 결과 생존율은 96.3% 이상이었으며, 실험군 간 통계적 차이는 없었다.

quote: The feeding rate experiments (5%, 8%, 11%, 14%, 17%) found that the relationship between feeding rate and domestication rate was modeled as Y=-0.5291X2+14.119X-23.814, with an optimal rate of 13.34% attributed to appetite stimulation via moderate starvation.
statement: 投喂率与驯化率的关系被建模，最佳投喂率为13.34%，这归因于通过适度饥饿刺激食欲。
text_zh: 投喂率与驯化率的关系被建模，最佳投喂率为13.34%，这归因于通过适度饥饿刺激食欲。
text_en: The relationship between feeding rate and domestication rate was modeled, with an optimal feeding rate of 13.34%, attributed to stimulating appetite through moderate hunger.

quote: Conversely, low-feeding rate induced oxidative stress, reducing the domestication rate.
statement: 低投喂率诱导氧化应激，从而降低驯化率。
text_zh: 低投喂率诱导氧化应激，从而降低驯化率。
text_en: Low feeding rate induces oxidative stress, thereby reducing domestication rate.

quote: The feeding frequency experiments (2, 3, and 4 times/d) showed 2 times/d aligned with the natural bimodal feeding rhythm, yielding better domestication.
statement: 投喂频率实验显示，每天2次符合自然双峰摄食节律，能产生更好的驯化效果。
text_zh: 投喂频率实验显示，每天2次符合自然双峰摄食节律，能产生更好的驯化效果。

quote: While 4 times/d markedly enhanced feeding-related learning and memory, as indicated by upregulated fosl2 expression and increased attack frequency.
statement: 每天4次投喂显著增强了与摄食相关的学习和记忆，表现为fosl2表达上调和攻击频率增加。
text_zh: 每天4次投喂显著增强了与摄食相关的学习和记忆，表现为fosl2表达上调和攻击频率增加。

quote:
The feeding duration experiments (2, 4, 6, and 8 d for chilled baitfish) exhibited
a significant decrease in oxidative stress after feeding for more than 6 d, which improved
the acceptance of subsequent artificial feed.
statement: 冰鲜饵料鱼投喂时长实验显示，投喂超过6天后氧化应激显著降低，并改善了对后续人工饲料的接受度。
text_zh: 冰鲜饵料鱼投喂时长实验显示，投喂超过6天后氧化应激显著降低，并改善了对后续人工饲料的接受度。
text_en: A feeding duration experiment with chilled bait fish showed that feeding for more than 6 days significantly reduced oxidative stress and improved acceptance of subsequent artificial feed.
intervention: Feeding chilled bait fish for over 6 days
outcome: 氧化应激与人工饲料接受度

quote:
Moreover, the expression of learning and
memory-related gene syt4 and the attack number were significantly up-regulated after
feeding for 8 d, indicating enhanced feeding memory for artificially fed food.
statement: 此外，投喂8天后，与学习和记忆相关的基因syt4的表达量和攻击次数显著上调，表明对人工饲料的摄食记忆增强。
text_zh: 此外，投喂8天后，与学习和记忆相关的基因syt4的表达量和攻击次数显著上调，表明对人工饲料的摄食记忆增强。
text_en: In addition, after 8 days of feeding, the expression level of the gene syt4 related to learning and memory and the number of attacks were significantly upregulated, indicating enhanced feeding memory for artificial feed.
intervention: Feeding chilled bait fish for 8 days

quote:
Thus,
prolonging chilled baitfish feeding could enhance feeding response by increasing learning
and memory, and reducing oxidative stress, thereby boosting domestication effects.
statement: 因此，延长冰鲜饵料鱼的投喂时间可以通过增加学习和记忆以及减少氧化应激来增强摄食反应，从而提高驯化效果。
text_zh: 因此，延长冰鲜饵料鱼的投喂时间可以通过增加学习和记忆以及减少氧化应激来增强摄食反应，从而提高驯化效果。
text_en: Therefore, extending the feeding time of chilled bait fish can enhance feeding responses by increasing learning and memory and reducing oxidative stress, thereby improving domestication effects.

quote:
Collectively, an optimized strategy (13.4% feeding rate, 2 times/d frequency, >6 d chilled
baitfish feeding) achieved a higher domestication effect, providing a scientific basis for
standardizing domestication and optimizing feed formulations.
statement: 综上所述，优化策略（13.4%投喂率、每天2次频率、>6天冰鲜饵料鱼投喂）实现了更高的驯化效果。
text_zh: 综上所述，优化策略（13.4%投喂率、每天2次频率、>6天冰鲜饵料鱼投喂）实现了更高的驯化效果。

quote: In existing studies, the beneficial and adverse effects caused by feeding frequency are often separated, which may lead to one-sided conclusions.
statement: 现有研究常将投喂频率带来的有益和不利影响分开讨论，可能导致片面的结论。
text_zh: 现有研究常将投喂频率带来的有益和不利影响分开讨论，可能导致片面的结论。
text_en: Existing studies often discuss the beneficial and adverse effects of feeding frequency separately, which may lead to one-sided conclusions.

quote: This lack of defined parameters contributes to consistently low domestication rates.
statement: 缺乏标准化的各阶段投喂策略参数导致驯化率持续偏低。
text_zh: 缺乏标准化的各阶段投喂策略参数导致驯化率持续偏低。
text_en: The lack of standardized feeding strategy parameters for each stage leads to persistently low domestication rates.

quote:
At the end of domestication,
the domestication rate of Chinese perch in each tank was
counted using 3 d of stable intake of soft pellet feed as the
criterion of domestication success, which was expressed as
follows: domestication rate (%) = number of fish feeding on
feed/total number of fish.
statement: 驯化成功的标准是鳜鱼在3天内稳定摄入软颗粒饲料，驯化率按摄食饲料的鱼数除以总鱼数计算。
text_zh: 驯化成功的标准是鳜鱼在3天内稳定摄入软颗粒饲料，驯化率按摄食饲料的鱼数除以总鱼数计算。
text_en: The criterion for successful acclimation is that mandarin fish stably consume soft pellet feed within 3 days; the acclimation rate is calculated by dividing the number of fish feeding on the feed by the total number of fish.
